units.plus_unit: 1% of a 1x ChatGPT Plus weekly Codex quota. prolite=5x (verified: gpt-5.6-sol tokens/unit equal on plus and prolite), pro=10x (user-stated, unverified)
units.weighted_tokens: uncached_input + cached_input/10 + 5*output (assumed price ratios, not fitted separately)

quota_price.fit: daily plus_units ~ a*weighted_tokens(gpt-5.6-sol) + b*weighted_tokens(gpt-6-*), no intercept, 53 days, R2=0.92

rereads_2026-10-05_to_10-09.method: scripts/reread.py: within-session reads (cat, sed -n ranges, head) of lines already read with no intervening write or compaction; sizes scaled to actual tool output; cost = entry + cached carry until the context shrinks
rereads_2026-10-05_to_10-09.caveat: writes outside apply_patch/redirects/sed -i/git are not detected, so the redundant share leans high; rg and codebase-memory queries are not counted as reads

settled_fact_contradiction.definition: An attempt or contract revision whose failed premise contradicts a fact that (a) was authoritative before the attempt began, (b) applies to the attempt's subject or boundary, and (c) remained valid throughout the attempt.

buckets.clear: direct contradiction of such a fact
buckets.arguable: likely preventable by better contract formation or relevance projection

settled_fact_contradiction.downstream_attribution: credit a contradiction with dependent revisions and quota until work rejoins a valid path; attribute conservatively
